acceptance_cases.expected: Request requisition and purchase-order fields, lines, context, attachments, submit_pr/submit_po/issue/cancel and deleteDraft preserve producer transitions. deleteDraft is distinct from cancel. U11 delegates sourcing/quote comparison to U12 and approve/reject review to U13 through frozen route/composition bindings; it does not reimplement either. Unsaved values never become approved.

All assigned surfaces implement READ-01 and the exact COMPONENT-CONTRACTS state mapping: filtered-empty retains filters; not-found is distinct from an empty collection; read-only/revoked map as specified. Draft reviewing/submitting/pending phases are separate from page state; late responses and return behavior preserve the authorized owner.
At 320/768/1024/1280/1440px and 200% text resize plus 400% reflow (1280px to 320 CSS px) the frozen flow retains fields/actions and keyboard access; themes use existing tokens.

P0 saves ONLY pr.title for real existing draft/rejected PR using versions['requests:'+id].version from authorized server. Header X-SF-Native-Owner checked inside transaction; wrong principal/host/version produces 0 commits; second actor denied; unknown response never retried or sold as approval/receipt C12.
